title: Lot-level top-3, on lots the scout did not auto-lock
desc: Three stat tiles from one offline run over 87 truth lots. How often it auto-locks: 20.7% (18 of 87 lots, 95% interval 13.5–30.4%). Right when it locks: 88.9% (16 of 18 locks, 67.2–96.9%). Top-3 when it doesn't lock: 65.2% (45 of 69 lots, 53.4–75.4%), the headline, in the accent colour.
